# winning branch's WHOLE residual: 0-or-more values, a count that can
# EXCEED any static seat. A single branch makes the nondeterministic
# modes deterministic, so these rows are green semantics.

# turns that one out into a region event (callVariadicRegion →
# eventFlags.variadicRegion), and the lowerer gives it a value-producing
# LOOP's representation — one simulated slot marked lw.variadic. The
# plain-residual row therefore compiles and has moved to
# What is left here are the two rows whose CONSUMER needs a static count.
